attributes.title: Agent Audit — User Prompts
attributes.description: Hook-captured user prompts in the cross-agent Agent Audit stream logs-agent_audit.user_prompt-* (the direct hook->Elasticsearch audit path, separate from OTLP/APM). One row per submitted prompt. No filter pills — the data view is the whole scope; @timestamp desc. Leads with the workstation login identity (user.id/name — no user.email; access is restricted at the stream), then the host (host.name/host.hostname), then the AI-agent identity (agent_audit.agent.provider/name/model) and the provider account/organization (agent_audit.agent.account.*/organization.* — null until a source supplies them), then the prompt (text — <REDACTED>/null unless plaintext mode — and length) and the conversation/turn correlation ids. Agent-cross-cutting: the agent is a document field, not in the stream name.
